kjv: [I had fainted], unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD
mine: If I had not believed that I would see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living—!
note: lule' "if not" begins a sentence that the psalmist leaves unfinished (the Masoretes mark the word as doubtful); the KJV completes it in italics with "I had fainted".
